title: Power Integral Bases in Polynomial Compositions
summary: In this paper, we study the monogeneity of a special class of composed polynomials of the form $ (f \circ g)(x) = (x^m + c)^n + a(x^m + c)^{n-1} + d(x^m + c)^{n-2} + b,$ where \( f(x) = x^n + a x^{n-1} + d x^{n-2} + b \in \mathbb{Z}[x] \) satisfies \( a^2 = 4d \) and \( g(x) = x^m + c \in \mathbb{Z}[x] \). Assuming that \( (f \circ g)(x) \) is irreducible over \( \mathbb{Q} \), we obtain necessary and sufficient conditions on the parameters \( a, b, c, d, m, n \) for the polynomial to be monogenic.
